metadata.title: A systematic review of studies investigating science teaching and learning: over two decades of TIMSS and PISA

design_fields.q1_rationale: The study is a systematic review and does not analyze student-level ILSA microdata, making plausible values handling not applicable.
design_fields.q2_rationale: The study does not conduct its own statistical modeling on TIMSS/PISA microdata, so the application of sampling weights is not applicable.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study does not analyze student-level survey data where schools are the sampling unit, thus school clustering is not applicable.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study does not mention any validation strategies, as it is a review of existing studies rather than an empirical analysis.
